business_problem: Orizon needed to centralize healthcare and billing data because fragmented processes and manual documentation were slowing fraud detection and making it harder to scale new medical rules.
solution_summary: Orizon uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Model Serving, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support healthcare fraud detection and documentation automation. Orizon needed to centralize healthcare and billing data because fragmented processes and manual documentation were slowing fraud detection and making it harder to scale new medical rules. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks Model Serving. Transaction, claims, risk, and event data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks Model Serving. The case study reports Minutes to build code documentation 63%, Of workflows automated with LLMs 1 billion, and 63%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Orizon reported Minutes to build code documentation 63%, Of workflows automated with LLMs 1 billion, and 63%, improving healthcare fraud detection and documentation automation with measurable gains in risk reduction, productivity improvement, and cost reduction.
